visa-preparation.entry_summary: Visa-free for business visits up to 6 weeks.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: Visa needed: Australia is on Saint Lucia's visa-required list. Apply through the Royal Saint Lucia Police Force visa office (about 5 working days).
steps: Apply at least 2 weeks before travel (visaoffice@police.govt.lc); an airport application is sometimes possible but can be refused.
Include 2 certified photos, return ticket, itinerary and accommodation proof.
documents: Invitation letter if staying with someone

laws.rule: Attitudes towards the LGBT+ community are mostly conservative throughout the Caribbean. Certain same-sex sexual acts are illegal in St Lucia. Showing affection in public may attract unwanted and negative attention. It is uncommon for opposite or same-sex couples to show affection in public in St Lucia. Read more advice for LGBT+ travellers .
